#!/bin/bash
# 测试解锁和锁屏的所有方法

ACTION=${1:-unlock}  # 参数: unlock 或 lock
echo "动作: $ACTION"
echo "=============================="

export DISPLAY=:0
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus

if [ "$ACTION" = "unlock" ]; then
  echo "=== 方法1: loginctl unlock-session ==="
  loginctl unlock-session 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法2: su user loginctl ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus loginctl unlock-session" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法3: xdotool key ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 xdotool key Return" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法4: 杀锁屏进程 ==="
  pkill -f "gnome-screensaver" 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ 杀掉 gnome-screensaver" || echo "无此进程"
  pkill -f "light-locker" 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ 杀掉 light-locker" || echo "无此进程"
  pkill -f "xfce4-screensaver" 2>/dev/null && echo "✅ 杀掉 xfce4-screensaver" || echo "无此进程"

  echo "=== 方法5: xdg-screensaver reset ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 xdg-screensaver reset" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法6: 模拟鼠标移动 ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 xdotool mousemove 640 400 click 1" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

else
  echo "=== 方法1: loginctl lock-session ==="
  loginctl lock-session 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法2: su user loginctl lock ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus loginctl lock-session" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法3: gnome-screensaver-command ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 gnome-screensaver-command -l" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"

  echo "=== 方法4: xdg-screensaver lock ==="
  su - user -c "DISPLAY=:0 xdg-screensaver lock" 2>&1 && echo "✅ 成功" || echo "❌ 失败"
fi

echo ""
echo "=============================="
echo "完成！看哪个方法显示✅"
